scope: Process-local concurrency and state preservation for current School and inherited human-session paths

regressionsBeforeFix.observed: Superseded cold callers returned before the newest overlapping refresh settled.
Age alone released a still-running turn; stale cleanup released its successor.
Cancelling one or two queued waiters admitted a successor while the predecessor still audited.
Real question dismissal was overwritten; simultaneous callers bypassed the gate; a reentrant kick started a second summary; checkpoint markers cleared existing stop/recovery pauses.

review: Readiness implementation independently reviewed by the compaction reviewer.
Audit-chain change independently reviewed and cancellation regressions rerun by the readiness reviewer.
Root inspected turn cleanup and compaction state/marker semantics; cleanup and additional gate/pause failures were corrected.
limits: Locks and fresh-read reconciliation remain single-process mechanisms, not distributed fencing.
A never-settling turn retains ownership until settlement or process exit.
Slow obsolete catalog requests can delay their callers within the existing School admission deadlines.
Completed discarded compactions retain reported usage; provider failures without returned usage and storage-failure accounting remain unqualified.
Full integrated build and suite after subsequent class integration are reported separately.
